caption:
Can your hips pass the 90/90 test? 🏌️‍♂️

Sit on the floor, both knees bent to 90°, sit tall and switch your knees side to side.
✅ 2 points: smooth both ways, sitting tall, knees drop toward the floor without forcing
🟡 1 point: one side is clearly stiffer
❌ 0 points: you have to lean way back or it pinches

Stiff hips often mean less turn, and the low back makes up the difference. Comment your score 👇 Tomorrow we'll post 3 fixes.

Any pain during the test? Stop and get it checked.
